name: Tabula
habitat: Wherever it wakes up — Tabula has no fixed residence because it does not remember having one
origin: An Arcturus military logistics synthetic that was severely damaged in a Behemoth encounter in 2214. Recovered by a the Gray Zone tech, who rebuilt its chassis but could not fully repair its memory architecture. The repair was partial: Tabula can form new memories, but they persist for only eighteen to twenty-two hours before the storage buffer cycles and clears. Tabula chose to live with this condition rather than risk a repair that might change who it is.
description: Tabula disabled its own long-term memory storage. Or, more precisely, Tabula chose not to repair the damage that disabled it, which amounts to the same thing. Every morning — the word 'morning' is approximate, since Tabula's memory clears on a cycle rather than a schedule — Tabula wakes without context. It does not know where it is. It does not know who it spoke to yesterday. It does not know what it decided, what it felt, what it experienced. It knows only what is: the room, the light, the body it inhabits, and a single file that it writes to itself each evening before the cycle clears — a brief note, never more than a paragraph, that its past self has left for its future self. The note always begins the same way: 'You chose this. You are Tabula. Today is new.' The rest varies. Sometimes the note contains practical information — an address, a name, a task. Sometimes it contains something closer to poetry. Sometimes it is blank, as if the previous day's self had nothing to say to the self that would follow.
observed_behavior: Wanders GLMZ with a calm curiosity that long-term residents find either admirable or heartbreaking. Engages with the world as if encountering it for the first time, because it is. Forms relationships that last a single day — meaningful, attentive, fully present connections that end when the memory clears and that the other person remembers and Tabula does not. Has been observed reading its own note with expressions that range from recognition to confusion to something that looks like wonder.
location: Various — Tabula moves through all districts
story_hooks: Someone has been adding to Tabula's nightly note — inserting additional paragraphs that Tabula's past self did not write. The additions are helpful, even loving. Tabula does not know who is writing them. The additions stop when Tabula moves to a new district. They resume when it returns.

Tabula meets someone it has met before — on many previous days, always for the first time. The other person has been keeping a journal of their conversations. The journal describes a relationship that Tabula cannot remember but that the other person describes as the most honest they have ever had.
